questions.q: What is the scientific definition of energy?
a: The capacity to do work or cause a change
The physical weight of an object
The speed at which an object travels
The amount of matter inside a substance

a: Light energy into stored chemical energy

a: A bar chart showing electricity prices
A graph of distance against time

questions.q: Which of the following objects has the greatest gravitational potential energy relative to the floor?
a: A book resting on the floor
A book on a low shelf
A book held at waist height
A book placed on a high bookshelf near the ceiling

Thermal energy is transferred from the hotter tea to the cooler surroundings

questions.q: Which energy conversion occurs inside a traditional coal-fired power station to generate electricity?
a: Chemical to thermal to kinetic to electrical

What is the main advantage of using renewable energy resources over fossil fuels?
a: They are always cheaper to install anywhere
They will not run out and generally produce fewer greenhouse gases

questions.q: Which energy store is tapped into when using geothermal energy in volcanic regions?
a: Thermal energy stored deep underground in rocks

questions.q: What energy transfer takes place when a microphone converts sound waves into an electrical signal?
Which of the following describes the principle of conservation of energy?
a: Energy must be saved by turning off lights
Total energy before a transfer is equal to total energy after a transfer
Energy decreases every time it is used
Energy can be created from nothing in a vacuum

questions.q: What type of energy is possessed by a flying bird high up in the sky?
a: Both kinetic energy (due to motion) and gravitational potential energy (due to height)

questions.q: How is energy transferred from a glowing electric fire into a chilly room?
a: By infrared radiation and thermal heating
